first_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: 2D hand-drawn game character walk KEYPOSE atlas. Reference: original approved Lina full-body sprite; match her exact face, proportions, costume and art style. Create ONE transparent PNG with exactly FOUR complete full-body sprites in an evenly spaced 2x2 grid. Each quadrant same canvas size and same character scale, clear empty gutters, entire hat, lantern, hair, staff and boots contained. No text, no frames, no labels, no ground/shadows.
Character: same cute chibi white-haired blue-eyed young witch, huge purple hat with brown belt and gold buckle, small cyan lantern hanging on viewer left of hat, cream dress, short purple cape, brown boots, wooden staff with cyan crystal held in her right hand (on viewer right). Same staff length, grip, costume, face, eyes open in ALL four drawings. Three-quarter FRONT view facing and walking diagonally toward screen right. Fixed camera, no rotation of viewpoint. This is natural small walking, NOT running, dancing, marching or kicking.
Four CONSECUTIVE anatomically believable keyposes covering HALF of a walk cycle, left-to-right top-to-bottom:
1 top left CONTACT: left leg slightly forward with heel just meeting ground, right leg slightly back with toe still touching; modest stride, hips centered between feet. Torso slight forward intent, free arm subtly counterbalances, staff carried comfortably off ground.
2 top right DOWN/WEIGHT ACCEPTANCE: weight settles onto forward LEFT foot flat on ground, left knee softly flexes, pelvis and head slightly LOWER. Trailing RIGHT heel lifts and its knee begins folding. Chest and shoulders respond, hat/cape lag minimally.
3 bottom left PASSING: LEFT leg supports body near upright under pelvis; RIGHT thigh travels forward with knee gently bent, right boot clearly OFF ground passing beside supporting ankle. Weight over left supporting foot, not floating or squatting; free arm and staff subtly counterrotate.
4 bottom right UP/PUSH OFF: LEFT supporting heel rises with left TOE still planted, body slightly HIGHER; RIGHT leg now reaching forward with its boot still airborne, preparing the next contact. Modest hip rotation, restrained shoulder counterrotation, cape follows.
Treat feet as attached to real articulated legs under skirt, ensure weight and silhouette clearly change across four poses. No crossed scissor legs, no detached parts, no stiff upper body copy, no extreme bobbing, no equipment mutation. Keep identical face and head size. Clean transparent alpha and crisp painterly linework, same as reference.
refine_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this 2x2 transparent four-pose Lina walk keypose atlas. Preserve the exact character identity, face, head size, all costume details, art style, transparent background, fixed three-quarter front facing screen right camera and four-cell layout. Preserve TOP LEFT contact and BOTTOM LEFT passing poses as closely as possible.
Change TOP RIGHT weight-acceptance pose: make planted forward foot bear weight, knee visibly but modestly bent; compress pelvis down a little so head/shoulders are 2 percent lower than contact. Trailing heel raised. No extreme squat.
Change BOTTOM RIGHT push-off pose: LEFT supporting leg is now trailing toward viewer left. Its heel must be clearly OFF ground, only the FRONT TOE touching baseline. Supporting calf elongated upward, supporting knee nearly straight. Pelvis 2 percent higher than contact. RIGHT swing leg extended moderately toward screen right, knee soft, its entire boot airborne with toe slightly raised preparing heel strike. This is an ordinary modest walking step, NOT a kick or run. Preserve the exact same staff angle and staff size as the other frames, subtle whole torso/shoulder counterrotation not just displaced legs. Natural weight balanced over supporting toe. Keep scale, image cell positions, and full uncut silhouette. No captions, no grid, no shadows. Only the requested animation pose corrections.
approval: User authorized four keypose experiment only. Not approved for final animation.
